notes.title: New game mode: Blast Arena*
notes.content:
Hello there,

I'm aware that many Bacon May Die just want to hop in, smash their keyboard for a few minutes and get back to the game they were downloading or queueing for. So, I added an even simpler and smaller game mode for exactly that purpose! 

It's still work-in-progress, so you can't earn coins, save your progress or grind stats. But all of that will be added soon. For now, just check it out and let me know what you think. Blast Arena unlocks with 50+ hit combo, hope that's not too hard to reach.

[list]
[*] New game mode: Blast Arena

[*] Fixed visual side of screen glitch during screenshake
[*] Fixed ninja enemy being invisible
[/list]

[list]
[*] Single limited zone
[*] Enemies spawn in waves and get progressively difficult

Seriously, if you have a wild idea for the game or want something improved - don't hesitate to post it. Even if I can't always make things happen (like online multiplayer), I love to read your feedback.

Cheers!

SnoutUp

notes.title: Daily missions, item markers and more outfits
notes.content:
Ho Ho Ho,

Hope you had a pleasant holidays and got some cool warm socks for Christmas! Before the year ends I wanted to push the last sizeable Bacon May Die update of 2021. 

The main highlight of this one is [b]Daily Missions[/b], which should give you more to do rather than being annoying for slowing down outfit unlocks. They will never reset, won't be tied to important content or achievements and countdown to the next daily mission is reduced while you play (depending on damage dealt and your XP level).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30346258/1781852c2d042d505d26319556642bea1e1a9bd5.png[/img]

Items unlockable with these missions will likely change in the future, but they should be granted to anyone who already passed that amount of days.

Also in this update...
[list]
[*] From now newly added items should be marked as such in the list
[*] Recently unlocked outfits should also be marked in the lest
[*] Added a few more outfits
[/list]

Hope it's not too buggy, because booster shot might knock productivity out of me for a day or two.

[b]So, let me know what you think about these daily missions. Yay or nay? What kind of tasks should I add in them?[/b]

Also, if you're wiling to give feedback, I'd like to know how could I improve the tutorial? I feel like it's pretty confusing and not fun at all.

Cheers!
-
SnoutUp

notes.title: Risky update with a new skill selection!
notes.content:
Hello there,

Warning: in the latest update I changed a lot of user interface code, so let me know if any buttons stopped working as I haven't got time to check everything. This is for the greater good as I'm trying to improve user experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30346258/c7b4c239b5f411eec7431491a69ada13cc673ff7.png[/img]

[list]
[*] NPC for skills (should spawn instead of the dresser now)
[*] New (and only) skill combo: DOWN+FWD 
[*] Draft version of skill selection menu
[*] Removed old "secret" skills
[*] Some boring passive skills for testing  
[*] Fixed "Rocket Rain" rockets not doing direct damage
[*] Fixed some projectile-related crashes
[/list]

Current DOWN+FWD skills are Saw Roll, Rocket Rain and Sword Throw (names might change), however I'm not sure if their flow fits this key combo, so will experiment further.

This new menu uses different interface controls, because I decided to save me some headache and introduce Enter key to it as well as proper grid controls, which would make navigating outfit/weapon menus easier, but I haven't got around redoing those yet.

I'm not sure about passive skills just yet. I think something like "critical chance increase" is a bit boring and should either be an additional item (trinket) or something players could level up during the run (another idea I have) that would reset with game over.

However I'm getting a bit worried that by adding too much I might ruin the attractive simplicity of the game :)

Let me know what you think!

P.s. I'm planning a small Workshop outfit contest, so keep your eyes open for that!

notes.title: Bacon May Die release plans
notes.content:
Hey there,

not sure if anyone can see this, but I hope you can! So, here's the thing.. After delaying Bacon May Die for ages I came to a conclusion that I'd like to release it in the current state for free. There are a few reasons for it... 
[list]
[*] No time to work on it due to other projects 
[*] Bacon May Die code is old and terrifies me
[*] No confidence if players like its control scheme
[/list]
However, I realize that this game can be pretty cool and one day I would like to maybe start working on a sequel... So, a free release would be beneficial, since I would get plenty of feedback on controls and gameplay as well as some audience for the next game.

Even the free release would likely to get some achievements, bug fixes and maybe Steam Workshop integration for outfits if I'll find time for that.

Alternatively, I can slap a $1-2 price tag, mostly so I could add Trading Cards (free games can't have them), but that might greatly impact potential audience reach.

What do you think?

Cheers!

-
SnoutUp

notes.title: Beta Update 0.0.0.11
notes.content:
What year is this? Good news is that game is still alive, but bad news is that, obviously, it is not getting closer to actual release very fast. But we'll get there, I promise! 

This update, while doesn't introduce any significant content additions, is important, because I developed a story framework (quests, traveling between areas, better controlled enemy spawns) I would like for you to test! 

So, a few new major changes:
[list]
    [*] Short story mode to test!
    [*] New item selection UI which doesn't require "ENTER" or "SPACE" presses
    [*] Experimental power move usage
    [*] A lot of smaller changes and improvements
[/list]

Current power move usage: HOLD up and press LEFT, DOWN or UP (again) to use a special attack. I find it better than previous combo-based system, but this one is too slow and clunky for my taste, so I will try to think of something else to use.

Story mode doesn't have saving yet, but it's very short and easy to finish.

New item selection isn't available with medic. pet or pilot yet.

Hopefully, the gap between updates will get much shorter now!


Send your feedback:

Cheers!

notes.title: Beta Update 0.0.0.5
notes.content:
We're moving forward again! Introducing... [b]power moves[/b]! Or spells, or combos. I'm not sure how to call them yet, but I added them to the game already. Looking forward to hearing from beta testers what they think about this new feature and how could I improve the combo sequences or spell casting!

To put it nicely in a list...

[list]
    [*] Spell system: input a combo, get a spell
    [*] Spells use the same ammo pool as ranged weapons
    [*] Ammo now regenerates while melee fighting & killing enemies
    [*] New enemy experiment: spider
    [*] Player can't dash through enemies anymore (only ground roll dodges)
    [*] Fixed few roll-related movement glitches 
    [*] Feedback button opens Steam community page
    [*] XP bar is now correctly centered after closing outfit menu (huge)
[/list]

[h1]Spells[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mAULOLI.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Air strike: UP, UP, UP, LEFT or RIGHT
[*] Sword throw: LEFT, LEFT, HOLD LEFT or RIGHT, RIGHT, HOLD RIGHT
[*] Spike wall: UP, UP, LEFT or RIGHT, DOWN
[*] Fart cloud: HOLD UP, press BACK (opposite direction) & HOLD
[/list]

Combo sequences, spell behavior and cost will likely change! If you have a crazy idea for a spell - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/646240/discussions/]post suggestion in forums[/url]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/c8NDxoA.gif[/img]

Cheers!

https://twitter.com/SnoutUp

notes.title: Update Delays
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! 

It's been a while, since the last beta update, so I wanted to give an update on the development progress. Frankly, it's not going too well, since due to lack of both motivation and time I wasn't able to move forward significantly with the game. This pushes planned Early Access release further away into the year, but hopefully not too far away from March.

On a more positive note, I distributed ~100 beta keys and got a lot of great feedback, both positive and negative. Really glad some people are enjoying the game in its current self already, but there's still much more I want to add and change before I'll see Bacon May Die as release-ready.

So, please stay patient, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/646240/discussions/0/1470842897552631633/]post your ideas and wishes for the game in the forums[/url], follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/SnoutUp]Twitter[/url] and I hope to bring you new game-related updates soon!

Cheers!
